happened: An email asked for policy and illustration materials today. The board put an agent on it, then asked who owns this and handed it to a named specialist.
issue: The next person still has to guess. The instruction is one broken sentence. It never says this is from sales, not a household. It never names who it is for, what to send, or which specialist.
why: When this is handed off, they would not know what to do, who it is coming from, who it is for, or what they need.

board.container: AI Agent — decides when the next step is not the same every time
